title: First-Line Supervisors of Material-Moving Machine and Vehicle Operators
description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of material-moving machine and vehicle operators and helpers.

tasks.text: Enforce safety rules and regulations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Material handling direction is on-floor supervision

dwas.name: Direct material handling or moving activities.

tasks.text: Interpret transportation or tariff regulations, shipping orders, safety regulations, or company policies and procedures for workers.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI explains policies; human handles live questions

dwas.name: Explain regulations, policies, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Resolve worker problems or collaborate with employees to assist in problem resolution.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Personnel problems need live judgment and trust

dwas.name: Resolve personnel problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Confer with customers, supervisors, contractors, or other personnel to exchange information or to resolve problems.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI suggests fixes; human resolves in operations

dwas.name: Resolve issues affecting transportation operations.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Plan work assignments and equipment allocations to meet transportation, operations or production goals.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Operational planning drafted; execution accountability human

dwas.name: Review work orders or schedules to determine operations or procedures.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle and equipment operation

dwas.name: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.

dwas.name: Inspect facilities to ensure compliance with safety, quality, or service standards.

tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Emergency direction is live, high-stakes human command

tasks.text: Monitor field work to ensure proper performance and use of materials.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI can review footage; human inspects physical workplace

dwas.name: Monitor work environment to ensure safety or adherence to specifications.
